notes.title: Updated Love's Crescendo Demo!💖
notes.content:
[b]First of all, thank you to the 7,700 people who have downloaded our demo for Love's Crescendo.
WE APPRECIATE YOU!✨[/b]

Second, while our studio has been working on the full game, we also decided to go back and make some improvements to the demo so you can get a better feel for how the game will be once it's finished. Below is a breakdown of our improvements and additions in our Love's Crescendo demo:

[b]Overall game improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*]Improved sprite and camera movement, SFX, and speaker highlight
[*]Added loading screen animation
[/list]

[b]Rhythm mini-game focused improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*]Rhythm mini-game UI improvements
[*]Added a "Ready, Start" animation before the rhythm mini-game begins
[*]A tutorial screen appears at the beginning of the first rhythm mini-game
[*]There is now a separate note indicator for holding versus pressing notes
[*]Rhythm game tracks have been re-synced to match the music better🎶
[/list]

You can follow us over on [url=https://twitter.com/SnowhavenStudio]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://blog.snowhavenstudios.com/]Tumblr[/url] to see snippets of Love's Crescendo as we continue development!
